name: Kohli combo silver (7mm ring , 3mm stud)
description:
7mm silver stud with 3mm white stone silver stud 

How to measure 

Measure your ear
Use a small ruler or flexible measuring tape.
Measure from the piercing hole to the edge of your ear where the ring will sit.
Double that distance and add about 1–2 mm for a comfortable fit.

description:

3. Measure the length in *mm*
4. Match it with the *Finger Circumference* in the chart above.

•Tip: If you're between two sizes, choose the *larger size* for a more comfortable fit.

This layout is simple, elegant, and matches a minimalist jewelry brand aesthetic.
